title: Tech Note: Taming The Splitter For Printout

historical_commentary.text: The specific splitter/printing quirk addressed here is tied to classic 4D form printing behavior; developers working with current 4D forms and print commands would need to verify whether this specific issue still applies, though the general goal — WYSIWYG consistency between screen and print output — remains a timeless usability concern.
related_updates: 4D's form printing behavior has continued to evolve since this note, and the specific splitter-printing quirk described may or may not still apply to current versions
